text:
olivia_pm: Quick idea for Q3: "commit bands" — rather than one reserved bucket, sell 3 ascending bands (baseline, surge, emergency) with explicit preemption ordering and different pricing. Want initial product take + ops/infra feasibility check.

raj_eng: sounds promising. What differentiates bands vs tranches or flex-lock?

olivia_pm: bands are simpler UI: fixed tiers that map to operational preemption levels. Baseline never preempted, surge is soft-preempt, emergency is last-resort but cheap to buy. Customers pick how many bands they want.

mina_ops: ops asks: need clear preempt rules and per-band observability. Also a global band_suppress flag to disable non-baseline bands in emergencies.

tom_sales: customers want predictable pricing. We should show example bundles: Baseline 1M tokens/mo ($X), Surge +500k (50% of on-demand), Emergency +2M (30% of on-demand but preemptible).

sam_sre: preemption semantics: soft-preempt = delay new requests until baseline drains; hard-preempt = reject new tranche requests. Also need a way to let in-flight finish.

raj_eng: infra approach: router maintains band_priority for each token. Admission checks baseline first, then surge, then emergency. We can mark requests with band_id in JWT-ish token. Preemption check is a single compare to global_utilization thresholds.

anya_research: QA note: simulate mixed-traffic patterns (spikes, steady high load, many tiny bursts) to see fairness and quality impact. Especially check emergency-band-induced latency spikes.

mina_ops: telemetry: band_consumption_{band}, band_preempt_events, band_latency_delta, band_eviction_rate. Add alert: band_preempt_rate > 2% for 10m -> page eng oncall + product.

olivia_pm: rollout plan: phase 1 = internal pilot for 5 customers, feature-flag per-region. Phase 2 = open beta with dashboard UX. Need billing mapping and legal language for eviction.

raj_eng: estimate: router + admission ~2 sprints, telemetry + runbook 1 sprint, billing mapping 1 sprint parallel. Total ~3 sprints with 2 teams.

tom_sales: pilot packaging: Starter (baseline only), Balanced (baseline+surge), Resilient (all bands). Offer 30-day trial for surge band.

mina_ops: runbook stub: when band_preempt_rate spikes, check region_util > 90% and recent infra incidents; consider disabling surge/emergency bands globally.

olivia_pm: action items: @raj_eng draft API + band token semantics; @mina_ops spec telemetry & runbook; @tom_sales draft pilot pricing; @anya_research create eval scenarios. I'll write spec doc and schedule a sync next Tue.

sam_sre: add quick kill: runtime_feature_flag band_enable_{region} for fast rollback.

olivia_pm: perfect — thanks everyone, will post proto in the specs folder and ping for review. 

raj_eng: will start a branch tomorrow.

mina_ops: ack.

tom_sales: looping in CSMs for pilot candidates.

anya_research: creating evaluation ticket now.
